Theme

soldier noun

also soldiers, serviceman, fellow soldier, comrade

classical

Liv. 7.26.7
Sen. Ep. 107.9
Traupman 169, 188

mīles, mīlitis m./f.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

In particular a foot soldier, as against eques (Lewis & Short); a private, mīles gregārius; to serve as a soldier, mīlitāre (Traupman 187).

Other words

  • commīlitō, commīlitōnis m. — fellow soldier, comrade

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Deiot. 28 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 314 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • mīlitāris, mīlitāris m. — a military man, a serviceman

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Hor. C. 1.8.5: cūr neque mīlitāris inter aequālēs equitat? (Lewis & Short); Traupman 376 · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • hunc imitāre, mīles

    copy him, soldier!Liv. 7.26.7

  • malus mīles est quī imperātōrem gemēns sequitur

    he is a poor soldier who follows his general grumblingSen. Ep. 107.9

See also army, war, weapon, guard, enemy.
